trello.name: Implement Queue Depth Alerts
trello.desc: Set up alerting on queue depth for the payment workers, with warnings at 1,000 jobs and pages at 5,000. Apply the same thresholds across the entire worker fleet. Responsible: Kofi.

trello.name: Fix Payment Worker Retry Logic
trello.desc: Revise the retry logic in the payment worker to implement exponential backoff with jitter. Cap the number of retries and route failed jobs to a dead-letter queue at the end instead of the front. Add tests to simulate processor 503s. Responsible: Marta.

trello.name: Update Database Connection Pool
trello.desc: Increase the database connection pool size to 100 and separate the worker and API connection pools to prevent resource contention. Both changes to be made in the same configuration file. Responsible: Kofi.

trello.name: Refresh Payment Incident Runbook
trello.desc: Update the payment incident runbook with current logging links, document the queue drain procedure, and verify the escalation phone numbers. Responsible: Priya (confirmation required by Kofi).

trello.name: Automate Status Page Updates
trello.desc: Automate the process of updating the status page when the checkout error rate alert fires, using the status provider's API. Start with the checkout alert and plan for future extensions. Responsible: Marta.

trello.name: Plan and Execute Payment Processor Failover Game Day
trello.desc: Draft and plan a game day to test the payment processor failover in a controlled environment, first in staging, then in production during a low-traffic window. Include a rollback plan and schedule a review of the plan in two weeks before execution. Responsible: Kofi.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis Version
trello.desc: Upgrade Redis from version 6.0 to 7.2, noting the configuration changes and persistence defaults. Schedule this upgrade with the infrastructure calendar to ensure a proper change window. Responsible: Kofi.
